The '''First Knowledge Council Chamber''' was a circular room at the summit of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It hosted meetings of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While the Tower and chamber were destroyed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Reconstruction Authority]] [[New Jedi Temple|rebuilt]] the Temple in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], seeing the Tower and chamber rebuilt as they had been in the days of the Old Republic.

==History==
===Old Republic===
Chambers for the First Knowledge Council were erected at the apex of the First Knowledge Tower upon its addition to the Temple on Coruscant. While the Council made use of this location for several centuries, it was ultimately destroyed by the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] when a group of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|ransacked]] Coruscant.<ref name="Timeline 1" /> After over a thousand years of fund-raising and rebuilding, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was finally able to allot enough tax money to finish the Council Spires by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

At the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], known as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine to all but his closest advisers, ordered the destruction of the Jedi Order through a military operation known as [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Knightfall]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] into the Temple and began to systematically slaughter its occupants.<ref name="ROTS" /> Following the abandonment of the Temple the chamber saw no use as the Council was dissolved. The Temple would survive for much of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Council Chamber leering over the surface of Coruscant for years. The ancient edifice was even re-inhabited briefly, as members of the [[new Jedi Order]] searched the destroyed hall for any information on the teachings of the old Order.<ref name="BRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> It wasn't until several years later that the five towers of the Temple collapsed, the Council chamber completely destroyed. The new Order would clear the rubble away and erect a [[Jedi Headquarters|small praxeum]] in their place on the roof of the Ziggurat;<ref name="Star Wars: Union">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref> though this too would be lost during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

===Reconstruction===
Following the retaking of Coruscant by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] donated a [[New Jedi Temple|new Temple]] to the Order in recognition of the Jedi's efforts during the war. Using blueprints salvaged from the old Archives the [[Reconstruction Authority]] erected the new Temple to near-exact specifications; though a new [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] pyramid concealed the restored Council towers.<ref name="FOTJO">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

==Layout==
Located at the peak of the southeast tower of the Temple, this circular chamber granted its occupants a rare glimpse of Coruscant. Circular in shape and accessed by a single turbolift,<ref name="SWCL" /> the room was lined with high arching windows, and a ring of five cushioned chairs for the members of the Council. Each of the stone seats was equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that could be used when a Council member was attending the meeting from a distant world. Erected atop the Council Spire of the Temple, the chamber was ringed by a small corridor set between the inner and outer sets of transparisteel windows which granted a panoramic view of the cityscape. The turbolift was specially crafted with Force-inspired dynamics in order to accommodate Jedi of different species and size. Incorporated into the five pillars spread around the room were the supports and wiring for the reception/transmission antennas that crowned the spire. These antennas were responsible for feeding data to [[Jedi command/Legends|Jedi Command]].<ref name="SWCL" />
